content.question: How is information gain computed?
options: As the difference between the impurity of the parent node and the weighted sum of the impurities of the children nodes.
As the sum of the entropies of all leaves.
As the ratio of the number of classes to the number of samples.
As the product of the parent impurity and the number of children.
content.answer: As the difference between the impurity of the parent node and the weighted sum of the impurities of the children nodes.
